label: Fits
definition: Source part is applicable to the target host (vehicle, machine, appliance model) described by an application record

label: Compatible With
definition: Source and target work together; stored once, evaluated both ways

label: Accessory For
definition: Source is an accessory for the target product or model family

label: Requires
definition: Source needs the target to function (batteries, hub, base unit); quantity may be stated

label: Includes
definition: Source kit or package includes the target as a component, with quantity

label: Part of Set
definition: Source and target belong to the same set or collection

label: Replaces
definition: Source replaces the target (inverse of superseded_by)

label: Superseded By
definition: Source is superseded by the target from an effective date; chains must be acyclic

label: Alternative To
definition: Source and target are equivalent under a stated basis (form-fit-function, functional, manufacturer-declared)

label: Cross-Reference
definition: Source corresponds to an external part number under another brand or issuer

label: Successor Of
definition: Source is the successor model to the target (model families and generations)

label: Variant Family Of
definition: Source and target belong to the same model family or series
